name: Large-holder reduction absorption
hypothesis: Buy after a confirmed reduction is absorbed without a new low and independent buyer balances rise.
spec: Setup: A decrease in large-holder inventory need not be bearish if new demand absorbs it. Entry: Buy after a confirmed reduction is absorbed without a new low and independent buyer balances rise. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the absorption base or on accelerated remaining-holder sales. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time holder balances and wallet clustering (on-chain, not connected)
